in “FershteBalancePatch\src\mod.js”, on line 24, it is referring to a scope that does not currently exist in the game. (this one). Which means it can’t read the properties of it nor modify them. That’s why it’s crashing. If you just add two forward slashes to the beginning of that line, it will not read it and the mod should work just fine:

//ELCAN Specter OS4x assault scope (OS4x) items[“544a3f024bdc2d1d388b4568”]._props.Ergonomics = modErgo, Becomes

//ELCAN Specter OS4x assault scope (OS4x) //items[“544a3f024bdc2d1d388b4568”]._props.Ergonomics = modErgo,
